Set up Spotify auto-sync ⌄

One-time setup. Spotify requires your own developer app for automatic playlist updates. This app only asks for permission to read your playlists; it cannot change Spotify songs.

Create an app at Spotify Developer Dashboard ↗, add the exact Redirect URI above under app settings, then paste its Client ID only here. Do not paste the Client Secret. Spotify's 2026 Development Mode requires Premium on the app owner's account.

Updates are checked at launch, when you return to the app, and approximately every 10 minutes while open. Changes cannot be received while the app is closed. New songs appear immediately after a successful sync, but chord charts still need to be added separately.

Each Spotify recording stays separate, even when the same song appears on several albums or in a medley. Spotify additions will not be assigned guessed guitar chords. Chord lessons show the original page from your PDF; these are published song-level arrangements, not independently verified transcriptions of every album performance.
Make this an iPhone app:

Once this site is hosted, open it in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → leave Open as Web App on → Add. Your songs and chord pages can work offline after the first complete load.
